verdict.rationale: Gazebo's own materials cover each part of the story. Robot dynamics run on multiple physics engines (ODE, Bullet, DART) through Gazebo Physics. Sensor data, optionally with noise, comes from lidar, cameras, depth, contact, force-torque, IMU, GPS and more. Robots and physically accurate environment models are available through Gazebo Fuel, with OGRE v2 for realistic rendering and plugins for robot, sensor and environment control. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of physics/sensor realism and sim-to-real fidelity.
